segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine and today we are cleaning, right Marco?
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们正在打扫卫生，对吧，马可？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we are cleaning our house.
segments.zh: 今天我们要打扫我们的房子。

segments.en: It's not one of our favorite activities but we have to do it and so we're going to take a look at a lot of great vocab related to household chores.
segments.zh: 这不是我们最喜欢的活动之一，但我们必须这样做，所以我们将看看许多与家务相关的很棒的词汇。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So let's take a listen to today's dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听今天的对话。

segments.en: Kevin, what is this mess?
segments.zh: 凯文，怎么弄得这么乱？

segments.en: It looks like a pigsty in here.
segments.zh: 这里简直像个猪圈。

segments.en: Clean this up.
segments.zh: 把这里收拾干净。

segments.en: Okay, dad.
segments.zh: 好的，爸爸。

segments.en: I will do it in a minute.
segments.zh: 我一会儿就收拾。

segments.en: Let me just finish this level of this game.
segments.zh: 让我先把游戏的这一关打完。

segments.en: No, I said now.
segments.zh: 不行，我说的是现在。

segments.en: Plus, you are grounded.
segments.zh: 还有，你被禁足了。

segments.en: You're not allowed to play video games.
segments.zh: 你不准再玩电子游戏了。

segments.en: I want you to make your bed, do the laundry and then come downstairs and sweep the floors.
segments.zh: 我要你整理床铺，洗衣服，然后下楼扫地板。

segments.en: That's so unfair.
segments.zh: 太不公平了。

segments.en: You have to pull your weight around here, young man.
segments.zh: 小伙子，你也得在家里尽自己的一份责任。

segments.en: My house, my rules.
segments.zh: 在我家就得守我的规矩。

segments.en: And I already mopped the floors, dusted the furniture and vacuumed the rugs.
segments.zh: 我已经拖过地、擦过家具上的灰，还用吸尘器清理了地毯。

segments.en: That's great but you still have work to do so get to it.
segments.zh: 那很好，不过你还有家务没做完，赶紧去做吧。

segments.en: So today on Language Takeaway, let's take a look at all the verbs and all the ways that we have to clean the house.
segments.zh: 所以今天在语言外卖上，让我们来看看我们必须打扫房子的所有动词和所有方式。

segments.en: So starting with the first one, we have to make the bed, make your bed.
segments.zh: 所以从第一个开始，我们必须整理床，整理你的床。

segments.en: Make your bed.
segments.zh: 做你的床。

segments.en: Okay, so this might sound quite strange because the verb to make is something we say for a lot of different things like make a deal.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以这听起来可能很奇怪，因为要制作的动词是我们所说的许多不同事物，例如达成交易。

segments.en: Make a mistake.
segments.zh: 犯错。

segments.en: Make a mistake.
segments.zh: 犯错。

segments.en: But here, we're making the bed.
segments.zh: 但在这里，我们正在铺床。

segments.en: That means we're putting the pillows on top of the bed and we're going to make sure the blanket is even.
segments.zh: 这意味着我们将枕头放在床上，我们将确保毯子是均匀的。

segments.en: So when you get out of bed, if everything is very messy, when you make it, you put everything in order on your bed.
segments.zh: 所以当你起床时，如果一切都很混乱，当你成功的时候，你就把所有东西都放在床上。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And well, it's also confusing because our next verb is to do the laundry.
segments.zh: 好吧，这也很令人困惑，因为我们的下一个动词是洗衣服。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So you make your bed but you do the laundry.
segments.zh: 所以你整理床铺，但你洗衣服。

segments.en: The laundry here means you clean the dirty clothes.
segments.zh: 这里的洗衣意味着你清理脏衣服。

segments.en: Right, right.
segments.zh: 对，对。

segments.en: So this is one of the very, I would say, confusing parts of English where it's kind of confusing when to use the verb make, when to use the verb do.
segments.zh: 所以这是我想说的非常令人困惑的部分英语之一，何时使用动词 make，何时使用动词 do 会令人困惑。

segments.en: So usually, you make a mistake as we say or you make a cake but you do your homework.
segments.zh: 所以通常，你会犯我们所说的错误，或者你做蛋糕，但你做你的功课。

segments.en: So in these cases, you just kind of have to memorize that you make the bed but you do the laundry.
segments.zh: 所以在这些情况下，你只需要记住你整理床，但你洗衣服。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So this is very common actually to do the laundry.
segments.zh: 所以这实际上是很常见的洗衣服。

segments.en: I have to go do the laundry today because it's an event.
segments.zh: 我今天必须去洗衣服，因为这是一个活动。

segments.en: You know, you have to gather your clothes and put in the detergent and wash it and dry it.
segments.zh: 你知道，你必须收集你的衣服，放入洗涤剂，清洗并擦干。

segments.en: So just remember, make the bed, do the laundry but then how do we clean those floors?
segments.zh: 所以请记住，整理床铺，洗衣服，但我们如何清洁那些地板？

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So the floor, we have to do two things.
segments.zh: 所以在地板上，我们必须做两件事。

segments.en: We sweep the floors.
segments.zh: 我们扫地。

segments.en: So the verb there is to sweep.
segments.zh: 所以动词要扫。

segments.en: And how do you sweep?
segments.zh: 你怎么扫？

segments.en: You actually use a broom to sweep.
segments.zh: 你实际上用扫帚扫地。

segments.en: So the broom is like a straw.
segments.zh: 所以扫帚就像一根稻草。

segments.en: It's like a brush almost that you use on the floor and you collect all of the hair and the dust and these things and you put it into the garbage bin.
segments.zh: 它几乎就像你在地板上使用的刷子，你收集所有的头发和灰尘和这些东西，然后把它放进垃圾箱。

segments.en: But after you sweep, then you need to use water to clean because obviously, sweeping is just for dry things.
segments.zh: 但是在你清扫之后，你需要用水来清洁，因为显然，扫地只是为了干燥的东西。

segments.en: Mopping is actually how you clean with water and soap.
segments.zh: 拖地实际上是您用水和肥皂清洁的方式。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So now the verb there is to mop the floors and usually, you use water, you use soap and you use a mop.
segments.zh: 所以现在的动词是用来拖地板的，通常，你用水，你用肥皂，你用拖把。

segments.en: So you use a mop to mop.
segments.zh: 所以你用拖把来拖地。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: The verb is to mop.
segments.zh: 动词是拖地。

segments.en: The noun, the object is a mop like you say.
segments.zh: 名词，对象是你说的拖把。

segments.en: So I'm going to mop the floors, right?
segments.zh: 所以我要去拖地板，对吧？

segments.en: So please don't come into the kitchen.
segments.zh: 所以请不要进厨房。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And well, now we need to clean the furniture and usually, on the furniture, we have a lot of dust.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在我们需要清洁家具，通常，在家具上，我们有很多灰尘。

segments.en: So we need to dust the furniture, to dust.
segments.zh: 所以我们需要把家具除尘，去除尘。

segments.en: To dust.
segments.zh: 尘土飞扬。

segments.en: Yeah, this is something we don't use for the floors really because we have this great verb to sweep.
segments.zh: 是的，这是我们没有用于地板的东西，因为我们有这个很棒的动词要扫。

segments.en: But with furniture and things like that, we say to dust and this means we're going to collect the dust off of the piano or the sofa or the table.
segments.zh: 但是对于家具和类似的东西，我们对灰尘说，这意味着我们要收集钢琴、沙发或桌子上的灰尘。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: And now, the floors we clean, the furniture we clean, but sometimes we have rugs or we have carpet in our house, usually in the bedrooms or we have a large rug in the living room and we need to clean that as well, but we don't really mop it and we don't sweep it.
segments.zh: 现在，我们清洁的地板，我们清洁的家具，但有时我们的房子里有地毯，或者我们的房子里有地毯，通常在卧室里，或者我们在客厅里有一个大地毯，我们也需要打扫它，但我们并没有真正擦它，我们也不会扫它。

segments.en: It's best to vacuum it.
segments.zh: 最好是吸尘。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So the verb is to vacuum and what is the noun, the thing we use?
segments.zh: 所以动词是真空，我们使用的名词是什么？

segments.en: A vacuum cleaner.
segments.zh: 吸尘器。

segments.en: A vacuum cleaner or just simply a vacuum.
segments.zh: 吸尘器或只是真空吸尘器。

segments.en: Now this is something that uses air to suck up all of the dirt and garbage.
segments.zh: 现在这是用空气吸走所有污垢和垃圾的东西。

segments.en: So it goes and it sucks up all of that bad stuff and so we don't have to dust it.
segments.zh: 所以它去了，它吸收了所有那些坏东西，所以我们不必除尘。

segments.en: And obviously, with carpet, we can't really use water.
segments.zh: 显然，对于地毯，我们不能真正使用水。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So carpet is a great tool for cleaning fabric like carpets and rugs.
segments.zh: 因此，地毯是清洁地毯和地毯等织物的好工具。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So that's all the ways that we can basically, the verbs that we use to clean around the house.
segments.zh: 所以这就是我们基本上可以用的所有动词，这些动词是我们用来打扫房子周围的。

segments.en: Let's listen to the dialogue again and we'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 让我们再听一次对话，我们会回来的。

segments.en: It looks like a pigsty in here.
segments.zh: 这里简直像个猪圈。

segments.en: Clean this up.
segments.zh: 把这里收拾干净。

segments.en: Okay, dad.
segments.zh: 好的，爸爸。

segments.en: I will do it in a minute.
segments.zh: 我一会儿就收拾。

segments.en: Let me just finish this level of this game.
segments.zh: 让我先把游戏的这一关打完。

segments.en: No.
segments.zh: 不。

segments.en: Now, plus you are grounded.
segments.zh: 现在，再加上你被接地了。

segments.en: You're not allowed to play video games.
segments.zh: 你不准再玩电子游戏了。

segments.en: I want you to make your bed, do the laundry and then come downstairs and sweep the floors.
segments.zh: 我要你整理床铺，洗衣服，然后下楼扫地板。

segments.en: That's so unfair.
segments.zh: 太不公平了。

segments.en: You have to pull your weight around here, young man.
segments.zh: 小伙子，你也得在家里尽自己的一份责任。

segments.zh: 在我家就得守我的规矩。

segments.en: But I already mopped the floors, dusted the furniture and vacuumed the rugs.
segments.zh: 但我已经把地板弄脏了，给家具撒了灰尘，并用吸尘器吸尘了地毯。

segments.en: That's great, but you still have work to do, so get to it.
segments.zh: 这很好，但你还有工作要做，所以去做吧。

segments.en: All right, so now let's take a look at some phrases, three of them on Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在让我们来看看一些短语，其中三个在 Flueny Builder 上。

segments.en: All right, now the first word here is pigsty.
segments.zh: 好吧，现在这里的第一个词是猪圈。

segments.en: The dad says, Kevin, it looks like a pigsty in here.
segments.zh: 爸爸说，凯文，这里看起来像个猪圈。

segments.en: Clean this up.
segments.zh: 把这里收拾干净。

segments.en: Right, so a pigsty.
segments.zh: 对，就是猪圈。

segments.en: It looks like a pigsty.
segments.zh: 它看起来像一个猪圈。

segments.en: Now, a pigsty is where pigs live, right?
segments.zh: 现在，猪圈是猪住的地方，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So, is it really a pigsty?
segments.zh: 那么，真的是猪圈吗？

segments.en: It's not really a pigsty.
segments.zh: 这不是一个真正的猪圈。

segments.en: There are no pigs living there, but to say that a room is like a pigsty means that it's very, very, very dirty.
segments.zh: 那里没有猪，但说房间就像猪圈，意味着它非常、非常、非常脏。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: It looks almost like the mud and the dirty place where pigs live.
segments.zh: 它看起来几乎像泥巴和猪住的肮脏地方。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So, he's saying, you're living in a dirty room.
segments.zh: 所以，他说，你住在一个肮脏的房间里。

segments.en: You need to clean this.
segments.zh: 你需要清理这个。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, a room or a house will look like a pigsty.
segments.zh: 所以，一个房间或一个房子看起来像一个猪圈。

segments.en: Now, the dad is actually making him do a lot of work because he says the kid is grounded.
segments.zh: 现在，爸爸实际上让他做了很多工作，因为他说孩子很脚踏实地。

segments.en: You're grounded.
segments.zh: 你被接地了。

segments.en: You're not allowed to play video games.
segments.zh: 你不准再玩电子游戏了。

segments.en: Now, a parent will ground a child, it's a verb, when the child does something bad.
segments.zh: 现在，当孩子做坏事时，父母会接地一个孩子，它是一个动词。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, maybe the child gets very, very bad grades at school and the parent says, ugh, you're grounded for one week.
segments.zh: 所以，也许孩子在学校的成绩非常非常差，而家长说，呃，你被禁足了一周。

segments.en: That means you can't go out, you can't play video games.
segments.zh: 这意味着你不能出去，你不能玩电子游戏。

segments.en: There are different rules in every family, but to say you're grounded means you're being punished for something.
segments.zh: 每个家庭都有不同的规则，但说你有脚踏实地意味着你会因为某事而受到惩罚。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, the verb is to ground and you can also be grounded.
segments.zh: 所以，动词是接地的，你也可以接地。

segments.en: And if you're grounded, you can say, I'm sorry, I can't go out today, I'm grounded.
segments.zh: 如果你被接地了，你可以说，对不起，我今天不能出去，我被接地了。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So, to be grounded is not a fun situation, but obviously the father is saying, listen, you're grounded.
segments.zh: 所以，被接地不是一个有趣的情况，但显然父亲是在说，听着，你已经脚踏实地了。

segments.en: You have time to do all of this work.
segments.zh: 你有时间做所有这些工作。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And well, this is something that my dad used to say to me, well, you have to pull your weight around here.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是我父亲过去对我说的，好吧，你必须在这里拉动你的体重。

segments.en: So, you have to pull your weight around here.
segments.zh: 所以，你必须在这里拉动你的重量。

segments.en: What does that mean?
segments.zh: 那是什么意思？

segments.en: To pull your weight.
segments.zh: 拉你的重量。

segments.en: Well, you think about it, if you're not carrying yourself, someone else is carrying you, it means that they're doing more work than they should be.
segments.zh: 好吧，你想一想，如果你没有携带自己，别人背着你，这意味着他们做的工作超出了应有的范围。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, you're basically being asked to do your part, to be responsible for yourself so that other people like your mom and dad don't have to be responsible for you.
segments.zh: 所以，你基本上被要求尽自己的一份力量，为自己负责，这样像你妈妈和爸爸这样的人就不必对你负责。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, you have to help out and collaborate.
segments.zh: 所以，你必须帮助和合作。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So, say there's three people, mom, dad, and a son.
segments.zh: 所以，假设有三个人，妈妈，爸爸和一个儿子。

segments.en: If mom does all the cleaning, all the cooking, all the washing, then the other two, they're not pulling their weight.
segments.zh: 如果妈妈做所有的清洁，所有的烹饪，所有的洗涤，那么另外两个，他们没有拉动自己的重量。

segments.en: So, she says, pull your weight, do some cleaning, do some washing.
segments.zh: 所以，她说，拉你的重量，做一些清洁，做一些洗涤。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So, if your mom cooks and then you wash the dishes, then you are pulling your weight.
segments.zh: 所以，如果你妈妈做饭，然后你洗碗，那么你就是在拉你的重量。

segments.en: You're helping.
segments.zh: 你在帮忙。

segments.en: You're helping out.
segments.zh: 你在帮忙。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: A lot of great stuff.

segments.zh: 但我已经把地板弄脏了，把家具弄脏了，然后用吸尘器吸尘了地毯。

segments.en: That's great, but you still have work to do, so get to it.
segments.zh: 这很好，但你还有工作要做，所以去做吧。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So, doing household chores, not a fun thing.
segments.zh: 所以，做家务，不是一件有趣的事情。

segments.en: But also, being grounded.
segments.zh: 而且，被接地。

segments.en: Why do we consider chores to be kind of like a punishment?
segments.zh: 为什么我们认为家务有点像惩罚？

segments.en: Well, there's punishment where you sit alone in your room and you think about your actions, and then there's punishment that's more proactive.
segments.zh: 好吧，当你独自坐在房间里并考虑你的行为时，会有惩罚，然后是更积极主动的惩罚。

segments.en: Mom and dad say, okay, well, he's grounded.
segments.zh: 妈妈和爸爸说，好吧，他已经停飞了。

segments.en: Let's have him work.
segments.zh: 让他工作。

segments.en: Let's make him do something.
segments.zh: 让他做点什么。

segments.en: Let's make him do something so that we're benefiting from his punishment.
segments.zh: 让他做点什么，让我们从他的惩罚中受益。

segments.en: I think it's also good when children are grounded because it makes them realize that they need to help out around the house.
segments.zh: 我认为当孩子们停飞时，这也很好，因为这让他们意识到他们需要在房子周围帮忙。

segments.en: This work, it doesn't get done magically.
segments.zh: 这项工作，它没有神奇地完成。

segments.en: There's actually someone doing it.
segments.zh: 实际上有人在做。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And it's not like, well, in many cases in many countries, people will have, like we saw in our previous lesson, a domestic maid, a cleaning lady, that will usually do everything so maybe the kid will become very comfortable and not really do anything.
segments.zh: 而且，在许多国家的许多情况下，人们不会像我们在上一课中看到的那样，一个家庭女仆，一个清洁工，通常会做所有事情，所以也许孩子会变得很舒服，不会真正做任何事情。

segments.en: Or very lazy.
segments.zh: 或者很懒。

segments.en: Very lazy.
segments.zh: 很懒。

segments.en: Even worse, yeah.
segments.zh: 更糟糕的是，是的。

segments.en: So, I definitely remember in my house we had chores because when it's not punishment, when it's your parents' expectation normally, that's called a chore.
segments.zh: 所以，我绝对记得在我家做家务，因为当这不是惩罚时，当你父母的期望正常时，这被称为家务。

segments.en: And they say, okay, Catherine, your chores this week, you need to take the garbage outside, you need to wash the dishes, and you need to make your bed every day.
segments.zh: 他们说，好吧，凯瑟琳，你这周的家务，你需要把垃圾带到外面，你需要洗碗，你需要每天整理床铺。

segments.en: And then maybe my brother had to help cook and clean the floor, mop the floors and sweep.
segments.zh: 然后也许我的兄弟不得不帮忙做饭和打扫地板，拖地和扫地。

segments.en: So we have different chores.
segments.zh: 所以我们有不同的家务。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And I guess this is more common especially if both parents work and everyone is collaborating or pulling their weight in the house.
segments.zh: 我想这更常见，特别是如果父母双方都在工作并且每个人都在家里合作或减重。

segments.en: And if you don't have a cleaning lady, for example.
segments.zh: 例如，如果您没有清洁女工。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Very interesting topic.
segments.zh: 非常有趣的话题。

segments.en: Well, that's all the time we have for today.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是我们今天所拥有的所有时间。

segments.zh: 如果你们有任何问题，任何意见，您可以在 Englishpod.com 找到我们。

segments.en: We hope to see you there.
segments.zh: 希望到时候见到你。

segments.en: We'll see you guys.
segments.zh: 我们会见到你们的。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
